title: AURA overview
description: Runs, LLM calls and tokens, scratchpad, MCP tools, orchestration and HITL for aura webserver, from its /metrics endpoint (OpenTelemetry GenAI and MCP semantic conventions). Token and routing counters start at zero when a config loads, so their first increment shows; run, LLM call, tool, task and scratchpad counts come from histograms and miss a fresh series' first event.

list.name: config
list.label: Config
list.description: The loaded agent config ([agent].name). A worker's series carry its config here and the worker's own name under Agent.

links.title: AURA agents
links.tooltip: One section per agent, main agents and workers alike

panels.title: Runs in flight
panels.description: aura.runs.active: agent runs that have started and not yet ended, every ingress.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Agent runs ended in the dashboard's time range (gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration count, main agents only).

panels.title: Run error ratio
panels.description: Share of runs in range that ended with an error.type (timeout, cancelled, client_disconnect, shutdown, stream_error).

panels.title: LLM calls per run
panels.description: Mean gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls over the range.

panels.title: Tool calls per run
panels.description: Mean gen_ai.invoke_agent.tool_calls over the range.

panels.title: Run duration p95
panels.description: gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration p95 over the range, main agents.

panels.title: Runs per second
panels.description: Runs ending per second by agent, ingress (http, a2a, slack) and mode.

panels.title: Run outcomes
panels.description: Runs per second by outcome. `ok` is a run with no error.type.

panels.title: Calls per run
panels.description: Mean LLM calls and tool calls per run.

panels.title: HTTP requests per second
panels.description: http.server.request.duration count. For a streaming completion this ends at the response headers; see Run duration for the whole run.

panels.title: Run duration p50
panels.description: gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration, request to final event, main agents.

panels.title: HTTP request duration p50
panels.description: Time to the response headers. A streaming completion returns them before the run starts, so its whole run is in Run duration, not here.

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Provider-billed input tokens in range, cached tokens included (Σ aura.usage).

panels.title: Cache read tokens
panels.description: Input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache. Stays empty until a provider reports cache usage.

panels.title: Cache write tokens
panels.description: Input tokens written to the provider's prompt cache. Stays empty until a provider reports cache usage.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Cache read tokens over input tokens in range; input tokens count cached tokens on every metered provider. Empty until a provider reports cache usage.

panels.title: LLM calls
panels.description: Inference calls in range, every agent and worker.

panels.title: LLM calls per second
panels.description: gen_ai.client.inference.duration count by agent, provider and model.

panels.title: LLM errors per second
panels.description: Inference calls that ended in an error (context_overflow, max_depth, cancelled, stream_error).

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description: Provider-billed tokens per second by agent.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_agent_name, gen_ai_provider_name, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_cache_read_input_tokens_total{instance=~"$instance",aura_agent=~"$config",gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (gen_ai_agent_name, gen_ai_provider_name, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total{instance=~"$instance",aura_agent=~"$config",gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Cache read tokens over input tokens, by agent, provider and model. A ratio that drops with a stable prompt means the cache prefix changed (system prompt, tool list, history edits).

panels.title: LLM call duration p50
panels.description: One inference call, first byte to turn end, by provider and model.

panels.title: Input tokens per call p50
panels.description: gen_ai.client.inference.operation.input_tokens: the context each call carried, so growth here is context-window pressure.

panels.title: Tokens into scratchpad
panels.description: aura.scratchpad.intercepted_tokens: tool output the scratchpad wrote to disk instead of the context window, in range.

panels.title: Tokens extracted
panels.description: aura.scratchpad.extracted_tokens: what the exploration tools (head, grep, get_in, ...) and read_artifact read back into the context, in range.

panels.title: Tokens saved
panels.description: Tokens into scratchpad minus tokens extracted: context the scratchpad kept out of the LLM calls. Each saved token is saved on every later turn of the run, so the token-usage effect is larger.

panels.title: Saved ratio
panels.description: Share of intercepted tokens never read back. Low means the agent reads most of what was intercepted, so the thresholds or the read tools' limits want a look.

panels.title: Outputs intercepted
panels.description: Tool outputs replaced with a scratchpad pointer, in range.

panels.title: Scratchpad reads
panels.description: Exploration tool calls that returned content, in range.

panels.title: Tokens into scratchpad by tool
panels.description: Intercepted tokens per second by the tool whose output was intercepted.

panels.title: Tokens extracted by read tool
panels.description: Tokens per second read back into the context by exploration tool.

panels.title: Scratchpad by tool
panels.description: Per tool over the range: outputs the scratchpad intercepted, the tokens they held, and the mean size of one.

panels.title: Intercepted output size p50
panels.description: Tokens of one intercepted tool output, by tool.

panels.title: Scratchpad read size p50
panels.description: Tokens one exploration tool call returned, by tool. Capped by [agent.scratchpad].max_extraction_tokens.

panels.title: MCP servers
panels.description: One row per agent, MCP server and instance: aura.mcp.server.connected as of the last connection attempt and aura.mcp.server.tools, the tools the server listed at connect time.

panels.title: MCP servers connected
panels.description: Connected servers against configured servers per agent and instance. A gap between the two lines is a server down.

panels.title: MCP calls per second
panels.description: mcp.client.operation.duration count (tools/call) by agent, server and tool. A worker's calls carry the worker's name.

panels.title: MCP errors per second
panels.description: tool_error is a result the server flagged isError; transport_error and cancelled are the client's.

panels.title: Tool executions per second
panels.description: gen_ai.execute_tool.duration count: tool calls as the agent made them, HITL wait and middleware included, native tools and MCP tools alike, by agent and tool. Every agent: single, worker and coordinator.

panels.title: Tool execution errors per second
panels.description: tool_error, tool_call_error or json_error as the result detector classifies them.

panels.title: MCP call duration p50

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, gen_ai_agent_name, aura_mcp_server, gen_ai_tool_name) (rate(mcp_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance",aura_agent=~"$config",gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Time inside the MCP client call, transport included.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_agent_name, aura_mcp_server, gen_ai_tool_name) (rate(mcp_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance",aura_agent=~"$config",gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Routing decisions per second
panels.description: aura.orchestration.routing: direct_answer, orchestrated or clarification, counted at every planning call including continuations. A post-execute coordinator call that fails before it routes counts as coordinator_timeout, coordinator_turn_budget_exhausted or coordinator_error; the run itself still ends ok.

panels.title: Planning cycles per run
panels.description: Mean aura.orchestration.planning_cycles per orchestrated run.

panels.title: Worker task outcomes per second
panels.description: aura.orchestration.task.duration count by worker and outcome (completed, blocked, agent_timeout, failed).

panels.title: HITL approvals pending
panels.description: aura.hitl.pending: tool calls waiting on a human decision right now.

panels.title: HITL decisions per second
panels.description: aura.hitl.decision.duration count by decision (approved, denied, timeout, cancelled).

panels.title: HITL decision wait p50
panels.description: Approval request to decision.
